in_sanskrit.name: अक्षित्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who cannot be seen or touched, the invisible. This name is derived from the Sanskrit root word 'aksh' meaning eye. In Hindu mythology, Akshita Pitr-Rishi is a sage who is believed to be unseen or invisible.

in_hindi.name: अक्षित
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who does not appear, the unseen. In Hindi, the name Akshit is derived from the Sanskrit root word 'aksh' meaning eye.

in_tamil.name: அக்ஷித்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is not seen by that (person or thing), the unseen. In Tamil, the name Akshit is derived from the Sanskrit root word 'aksh' meaning eye.

in_telugu.name: అక్షిట్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is not seen, the unseen. In Telugu, the name Akshit is derived from the Sanskrit root word 'aksh' meaning eye.

in_marathi.name: Akshit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Immutable, Inevitable, Fixed
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akshit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Akshit means immutable or inevitable. It suggests a fixed, unchanging nature that is beyond the reach of time and circumstances. This name is often given to a child who is expected to bring prosperity and wealth to the family.
